subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Archaeologists found part of an ancient road under a modern street.”?
options: He placed it carefully by the door and walked away.
The students made paper leaves and placed them on the window.
It was made of stones placed carefully together.
It saved time, kept papers together, and made responsibility clear.
